        "contents": "/**\n * QR Code quick status page\n * Shows instant room availability status with split-screen colored design\n */\nexport default async function QRQuickStatusPage({ params }: QRPageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check authentication\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if verified\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n\n  // Fetch current reservation\n  const { data: currentReservation } = await supabase\n    .from(\"reservations\")\n    .select(&#96;\n      *,\n      user:profiles(id, full_name),\n      team:teams(id, name)\n    &#96;)\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n    .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n    .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso)\n    .single();\n\n  // Fetch open issues\n  const { data: issues } = await supabase\n    .from(\"room_issues\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"open\");\n\n  const roomIssues = (issues || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const isLocked = roomIssues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n  const otherIssues = roomIssues\n    .filter((i) =&gt; i.issue_type !== \"locked\")\n    .map((i) =&gt; {\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n        mess: \"Nepořádek\",\n        technical: \"Technický problém\",\n        other: \"Jiné\",\n      };\n      return labels[i.issue_type] || i.issue_type;\n    });\n\n  // Determine status\n  let status: 'free' | 'occupied' | 'locked' = 'free';\n  if (isLocked) {\n    status = 'locked';\n  } else if (currentReservation) {\n    status = 'occupied';\n  }\n\n  // Build response data\n  const quickStatusData = {\n    room:\n,\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Room detail page with calendar and reservation form\n */\nexport default async function RoomDetailPage({ params }: RoomDetailPageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if verified\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Fetch data in parallel\n  // Include past 7 days for navigation + future 14 days\n  const today = new Date();\n  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);\n  \n  const oneWeekAgo = new Date(today);\n  oneWeekAgo.setDate(oneWeekAgo.getDate() - 7);\n  \n  const twoWeeksLater = new Date(today);\n  twoWeeksLater.setDate(twoWeeksLater.getDate() + 14);\n\n  const oneWeekAgoStr = oneWeekAgo.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0];\n  const twoWeeksLaterStr = twoWeeksLater.toISOString().split(\"T\")[0];\n\n  const [reservationsResult, issuesResult, alternativeRoomsResult, breaksResult] = await \n;\n}",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Main reservations page showing all rooms and user's reservations\n */\nexport default async function ReservationsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  \n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if verified\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  // Fetch rooms with current reservations and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n  \n  const [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // All rooms\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .order(\"code\"),\n    \n    // Current and upcoming reservations for today\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .lte(\"start_time\", new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n    \n    // Open issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"room_id, issue_type\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n    \n    // User's own reservations\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(10),\n    \n    // Get reservation IDs user has joined\n    supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(\"reservation_id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id),\n    \n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  // Treat errors as \"no identity\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const emailIdentityCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasEmailIdentity(supabase),\n    \"hasEmailIdentity\",\n  );\n  if (!emailIdentityCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Treat errors as \"no profile\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const linkedProfileCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasLinkedProfile(supabase),\n    \"hasLinkedProfile\",\n  );\n  if (!linkedProfileCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Strip all query parameters (e.g., from email verification or QR code)\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Strip hash as well\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // For protected routes (dashboard, etc.), we need to check verification\n  // This is done on the page level for better UX with proper error messages\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  // Get user's email address\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const userEmail = user?.email || \"your email\";\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { EmailVerificationRealtimeListener } from \"@/components/email-verification-realtime-listener\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Get search params once\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  // Respect the next parameter if provided, otherwise use default logged in page\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(next ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\"&gt;\n      &lt;EmailVerificationRealtimeListener /&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"absolute top-6 right-6 md:top-10 md:right-10\"&gt;\n        &lt;LogoutButton /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm next={next} /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect(\"/\");\n  }\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"is_verified, role\")\n    .eq(\"id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile?.is_verified) {\n    redirect(\"/verify\");\n  }\n\n  if (profile.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp; { room: Room; team: { id: string; name: string } })[];\n  const breaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile ID\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns The profile ID if found, null otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "/**\n * Public NFC/QR entry point for room reservations\n * - If user is logged in, redirects to dashboard version\n * - If not logged in, shows room status and login prompt\n */\nexport default async function RezerevacePage({ params }: RezervecePageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is logged in\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // If logged in, redirect to dashboard version\n  if (user) {\n    redirect(&#96;/dashboard/reservations/${code}&#96;);\n  }\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Fetch current reservation and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n  \n  const [currentResResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .lte(\"start_time\", now)\n      .gt(\"end_time\", now)\n      .single(),\n    \n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n  ]);\n\n  const currentReservation = currentResResult.data as Reservation | null;\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const isLocked = issues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n\n  // Determine status\n  const isOccupied = currentReservation !== null;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen bg-background flex items-center justify-center p-4\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function ReservationsPage() {\nconst [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await \n\n\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id),\n    \n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles!reservations_user_id_fkey(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"is_cowork_open\", true)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(50), // Increased limit to catch both joined and available\n  ]);\n\n  // Process rooms with status\n  const rooms = roomsResult.data || [];\n  const reservations = reservationsResult.data || [];\n  const issues = issuesResult.data || [];\n  const myReservations = (myReservationsResult.data || []) as ReservationWithDetails[];\n  \n  // Get IDs of reservations user has joined\n  const joinedReservationIds = new Set(\n    (joinedIdsResult.data || []).map((jp: any) =&gt; jp.reservation_id)\n  );\n  \n  // Split all coworks into joined and available\n  const allCoworks = (coworksResult.data || []) as ReservationWithDetails[];\n  const joinedCoworks = allCoworks.filter(c =&gt; joinedReservationIds.has(c.id));\n  const availableCoworks = allCoworks.filter(c =&gt; \n    !joinedReservationIds.has(c.id) &amp;&amp; c.user_id !== user.id // Exclude joined and own reservations\n  );\n  \n  console.log(\"User ID:\", user.id);\n  console.log(\"Joined reservation IDs:\", Array.from(joinedReservationIds));\n  console.log(\"All coworks count:\", allCoworks.length);\n  console.log(\"Joined coworks:\", joinedCoworks.map(c =&gt; ({ id: c.id, title: c.title })));\n  console.log(\"Available coworks:\", availableCoworks.map(c =&gt; ({ id: c.id, title: c.title })));\n\n  const roomsWithStatus: RoomWithStatus[] = rooms.map\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile ID\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns The profile ID if found, null otherwise\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfileId(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1)\n    .single();\n\n  // Return null if query failed or no profile found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  return profiles.id;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    // Check if code matches\n    if (verificationCode.code !== code) {\n      // Increment attempts\n      await supabase\n        .from(\"verification_codes\")\n        .update({ attempts: verificationCode.attempts + 1 })\n        .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n      const remainingAttempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS - verificationCode.attempts - 1;\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        {\n          error: &#96;Neplatný kód. Zbývající pokusy: ${remainingAttempts}&#96;,\n        },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Code is valid! Mark as used\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .update({ used: true })\n      .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n    // Get role and team from pre_registered_emails\n    const { data: preRegistered, error: preRegError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .select(\"role, team_id\")\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase())\n      .single();\n\n    if (preRegError || !preRegistered) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to get pre_registered_emails:\", preRegError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst data z registrace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Update profile: set is_verified, school_email, role, and team_id from pre_registered\n    const { error: profileError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"profiles\")\n      .update({\n        is_verified: true,\n        school_email: school_email.toLowerCase(),\n        role: preRegistered.role,\n        team_id: preRegistered.team_id,\n      })\n      .eq(\"id\", user.id);\n\n    if (profileError) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to update profile:\", profileError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se aktualizovat profil\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Claim the pre-registered email\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .update({\n        claimed_by: user.id,\n        claimed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      })\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase());\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      verified: true,\n\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function QRQuickStatusPage({ params }: QRPageProps) {\n\n\n  // Build response data\n  const quickStatusData = {\n    room: {\n      id: room.id,\n      code: room.code,\n      name: room.name,\n      description: room.description,\n    },\n    status,\n    issues: {\n      isLocked,\n      otherIssues,\n    },\n  };\n\n  // Add current reservation details if occupied\n  let currentReservationData = undefined;\n  let alternativeRooms = undefined;\n\n  if (currentReservation) {\n    const endTime = new Date(currentReservation.end_time);\n    const endsInMinutes = Math.round((endTime.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60));\n    \n    const occupantName = currentReservation.user?.full_name || \n                        currentReservation.team?.name || \n                        \"Neznámý\";\n\n    currentReservationData = {\n      title: currentReservation.title,\n      occupantName,\n      personCount: currentReservation.person_count,\n      startTime: currentReservation.start_time,\n      endTime: currentReservation.end_time,\n      endsInMinutes,\n    };\n\n    // Fetch alternative rooms that are currently free\n    const { data: allRooms } = await supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .neq(\"id\", room.id)\n      .order(\"code\");\n\n    if (allRooms &amp;&amp; allRooms.length &gt; 0) {\n      // Check which rooms are free\n      const { data: otherCurrentReservations } = await supabase\n        .from(\"reservations\")\n        .select(\"room_id\")\n        .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n        .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n        .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso);\n\n      const occupiedRoomIds = new Set(\n        (otherCurrentReservations || []).map((r) =&gt; r.room_id)\n      );\n\n      const freeRooms = allRooms.filter((r) =&gt; !occupiedRoomIds.has(r.id));\n\n      // Sort by relevance\n      const sortedFreeRooms = sortAlternativeRooms(freeRooms, room);\n\n      // Take top 3\n      alternativeRooms = sortedFreeRooms.slice(0, 3).map((r) =&gt; ({\n        id: r.id,\n        code: r.code,\n        name: r.name,\n      }));\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;RoomQuickStatus\n      {...quickStatusData}\n}",

        "contents": "- Příklad: &#96;page.tsx&#96; je server, &#96;login-form.tsx&#96; je client\n\n#### 2. Supabase integrace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Server component\nconst supabase = await createClient();\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n// Client component  \nconst supabase = createClient();\nawait supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3.         "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/reservations/[id]\n * Get a single reservation\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try {\n    const { id } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { data: reservation, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"id\", id)\n      .single();\n\n    if (error || !reservation) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Rezervace nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data: reservation });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/reservations/[id] error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * PATCH /api/reservations/[id]\n * Update a reservation\n */\nexport async function PATCH(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export function useEmailVerificationRealtime() {\n() =&gt; {\nconst setupRealtimeSubscription = async \n\n\n        channelRef.current = channel;\n\n        // Listen for verified_work_email_changed events\n        channel.on(\n          \"broadcast\",\n          { event: \"verified_work_email_changed\" },\n          async () =&gt; {\n            if (!mounted) return;\n\n            try {\n              // Refresh session to get updated user data\n              const { error: refreshError } = await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n              if (refreshError) {\n                console.error(\"Failed to refresh session:\", refreshError);\n                return;\n              }\n\n              // Get current pathname to determine if we should redirect\n              const currentPath = window.location.pathname;\n\n              // If user is on verify-email page, redirect to default logged-in page\n              // Otherwise, refresh the current page to show updated state\n              if (currentPath === \"/auth/verify-email\") {\n                router.push(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n              } else {\n                // Refresh current page to show updated verification status\n                router.refresh();\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              console.error(\"Error handling verification change:\", error);\n            }\n          }\n        );\n\n        // Set auth before subscribing (required for private channels)\n        await supabase.realtime.setAuth();\n\n        // Subscribe to channel\n        channel.subscribe((status, err) =&gt; {\n          if (status === \"SUBSCRIBED\") {\n            isSubscribedRef.current = true;\n          } else if (status === \"CHANNEL_ERROR\") {\n            console.error(\"Channel subscription error:\", err);\n            isSubscribedRef.current = false;\n          } else if (status === \"CLOSED\") {\n            isSubscribedRef.current = false;\n          }\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(\"Error setting up Realtime subscription:\", error);\n      }\n    };\n\n    // Set up subscription\n    setupRealtimeSubscription();\n\n    // Cleanup function\n    return () =&gt; {\n      mounted = false;\n    }\n  }\n}",
